violation_type.title: First Aid Kit - Easily Accessible to Employees (26 TAC §746.4001(3))
violation_type.short_title: First Aid Kit - Easily Accessible to Employees
violation_type.typical_finding: The first aid kit in the Head Start room was accessible to children in care.      Note:  Corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the first aid kit and placed the first aid kit in the cabinet.

finding_variants.text: The first aid kit in the Head Start room was accessible to children in care.      Note:  Corrected at inspection when caregiver removed the first aid kit and placed the first aid kit in the cabinet.
The first aid kit was observed to be located in the truck of the vehicle used for transportation and was not readily accessible by the driver.
